Summary of the content of the sample data pack for the Terrain Processor demo map project for Arma 3. Use with the [[Terrain Processor: Tutorial|Terrain Processor Tutorial]].

Export folder "map_TPDemo" to P:\ a3\..
* [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Map_TPDemo''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Project folder</span>
** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Data''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Data folder for binarizing</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Layers''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Satellite and mask textures generated by Terrain Builder</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Roads''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Roads shapefile and roads configuration file. Don't forget that roads shapefile has to have origin at 200 000,0</span>
**** roads.dbf <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Database file for shapefile</span>
**** roads.shp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Roads shapefile</span>
**** roads.shx <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Roads shapefile index file</span>
**** RoadsLib.cfg <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Configuration file for roads</span>
*** L-Middle_mco.paa <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Missing description</span>
*** pictureMap_ca.paa <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain splash screen </span>
***s_satout_co.paa <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Texture for outside terrain.</span>
** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Map_TPDemo.Cache'''
** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Map_TPDemo.Layers'''
** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Map_TPDemo.Shapes'''
**  [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Source''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Source data folder</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Heightmap''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// All heightmap files (original, with perlin noise in forests and with roads smooth)</span>
**** heightmap.asc <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);"><span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// UTM heightmap 1024x1024, 4 meters cell</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''OpenStreetMap''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">//Folder for downloaded OSM data</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''Shapefiles''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// All shapefiles used for project (forests, roads, ...)</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''TemplateLibs''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Object templates libraries</span>
**** arma 2 buildings.tml <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Arma 2 buildings templates</span>
**** arma 2 bush.tml <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Arma 2 bush templates</span>
**** arma 2 misc.tml <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Arma 2 miscellaneous objects templates</span>
**** arma 2 trees.tml <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Arma 2 trees templates</span>
*** [[image:ico_folder.png]] '''TerrainProcessorOutput''' <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Output folder for Terrain Processor tasks</span>
*** Forests.tpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Processor project for forests / treelines, plants all trees in terrain</span>
*** HeightmapGeneration.tpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Processor project to create UTM heightmap from Geodetic heightmap, insert perlin noise in trees and smooth terrain under roads</span>
*** layers.cfg <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Builder layer configuration file</span>
*** mapLegend.png <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Layers map legend image file</span>
*** mask.tif <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Layers mask file</span>
*** Powerlines.tpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Processor project for placing powerline poles</span>
*** RoadVergePosts.tpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">//Terrain Processor project for placing road stones near roads</span>
*** satellite.tif <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Satellite image file</span>
*** satelitte.wld <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Satellite image projection file</span>
*** HayBales.tpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Processor project for placing haybales</span>
** cfgAmbient.hpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Config include: configuration file for ambient life.</span>
** cfgClutter.hpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Config include: terrain clutter settings.</span>
** cfgSurfaces.hpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Config include: terrain surfaces settings.</span>
** config.cpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain configuration file</span>
** Map_TPDemo.hpp <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Config include: Places names file, generated automatically by Terrain Builder upon WRP export.</span>
** map_tpdemo.tv4p <span style="color: rgb(128,128,128);">// Terrain Builder project file.</span>
